title: مارتينيلي في الهلال.. نهاية المسلسل والكشف عن موعد وصوله

title: اتفق مع اللاعب.. مانشستر سيتي يمهد لصفقة تاريخية من ليفربول
summary: ليفربول يضع شرطا لإتمام الصفقة
body: ليفربول يضع شرطا لإتمام الصفقة يبدو أن مانشستر سيتي، الذي حقق بداية رائعة في الدوري الإنجليزي الممتاز، غير راضٍ عن تشكيلته الحالية ويرغب في المزيد. ووفقا لصحيفة " موندو ديبورتيفو "، لم يغلق النادي فترة الانتقالات، وتشير التقارير الواردة من هولندا إلى أنه يجري محادثات للتعاقد مع كودي جاكبو، مهاجم ليفربول البالغ من العمر 27 عامًا. وأفادت التقارير بأن النادي الإنجليزي قد توصل إلى اتفاق شخصي مع وكلاء اللاعب الدولي الهولندي، وهو على وشك تقديم عرض بقيمة 100 مليون يورو إلى ليفربول. يمكنكم مناقشة الموضوعات والأخبار بشكل أعمق في منتديات "كووورة" إذا انضم جاكبو إلى مانشستر سيتي بهذا المبلغ، فسيصبح فوراً أغلى صفقة انتقال في تاريخ هولندا.  ويحمل هذا اللقب حالياً فرينكي دي يونج، الذي انتقل من أياكس إلى برشلونة عام 2019 مقابل 75 مليون يورو بالإضافة إلى 11 مليون يورو كحد أقصى كإضافات. مع ذلك، لم يُعطِ ليفربول الضوء الأخضر لرحيل اللاعب بعد. ولا يرغب في السماح لجاكبو بالرحيل إلا بعد إيجاد بديل مناسب لمهاجم آيندهوفن السابق.  ويقترب برادلي باركولا (باريس سان جيرمان) من الانضمام، لكن ليفربول يبحث أيضًا عن جناح مميز آخر. يمكنكم مناقشة الموضوعات والأخبار بشكل أعمق في منتديات "كووورة"

title: I took my Android phone off silent mode and started using AI ringtones — and I love it
summary: Some imagination and an AI tool is all you need.
body: As someone who grew up in the 90s, I can tell you that ringtones were once a major status symbol. It meant you had a cutting-edge phone capable of such witchcraft, after all. Unfortunately, it took less than a decade for custom ringtones to go from impressive to something most people considered tacky. The rise of smartphones and the bombardment of notifications didn’t help custom ringtones any, either. Even if not as popular as they once were, ringtones are still a great way to add a little flair to your phone, as long as you don’t go overboard. These days, there are tons of sources for ringtones, from dedicated apps to websites that allow you to download ringtone files. Many phones can even take full tunes you own and automatically cut them into ringtones.

body: Google is playing catch-up with the new Pixel 11 Pro Fold . The North American foldable market is as competitive as ever, with Samsung, Motorola, and Google all vying for a piece of the pie. title: فليك: حمزة عبد الكريم يستحق المشاركة.. وحالته تشبه هذا اللاعب
summary: الفرصة قريبة من النجم المصري
body: الفرصة قريبة من النجم المصري علق هانز فليك، مدرب برشلونة، على موقع المهاجم المصري حمزة عبد الكريم من المشاركة في المباريات مع البارسا خلال الموسم الحالي. وكان حمزة عبد الكريم تألق بشكل واضح مع الفريق الأول برشلونة خلال فترة الإعداد ، إلا أنه لم يشارك مطلقا خلال أول مباراتين للبارسا بالليجا. وقال فليك، في المؤتمر الصحفي لمباراة رايو فاليكانو بالدوري الإسباني : "هل رافينيا هو الأفضل لشغل مركز المهاجم الصريح حاليًا؟ بصفته مهاجمًا، يجب عليه أن يبدأ الضغط، وهو يقوم بذلك بشكل جيد جدًا. الجميع يعرف أنه قائد ويدرك أهميته. بالإضافة إلى ذلك، فهو فعال أيضًا أمام المرمى. وهناك لاعبون آخرون مثل فيرمين يمكنهم القيام بذلك أيضًا". وسئل فليك "لماذا لا يشارك حمزة كثيرًا؟".. وأجاب المدرب الألماني: "الأمر ليس سهلًا. نفكر دائمًا في منح الفرص لمن يستحقها، وهو يستحقها بسبب تدريباته الرائعة، كما أن لديه العقلية المناسبة". وتابع: "حمزة يستحق اللعب وسيشارك بالفعل. سنمنحه دقائق حتى يتمكن من إظهار ما يستطيع فعله في مباراة بالدوري. إن حالته تشبه بريان فاريناس الذي فاجأني كثيرًا ويمتلك موهبة كبيرة ومركز بنسبة مئة بالمئة، لكنه يحتاج إلى الدقائق". يمكنكم مناقشة الموضوعات والأخبار بشكل أعمق في منتديات "كووورة"

title: Google made Android 17’s best feature a Pixel 11-exclusive. This free app does it better
summary: Stroll lets me earn time on social media by walking first.
body: Credit: Tushar Mehta / Android Authority Google’s latest Pixel 11 series has been making waves since its announcement earlier this month. If you weren’t so savvy about the (stealthy) upgrades — or the new colors — that it brings, you’d probably pass the phones off as the old Pixel 10 series. But if you do make the effort to inquire about the improvements the Pixel 11 brings, you’ll find a few good, handy additions. A few of these include better control over the camera’s tones , the new, enticing Tap-to-Share , real-time translations for podcasts and videos, and more. One of my favorite inclusions is Android 17’s new Digital Wellbeing feature, called Pause Point . When enabled, it forces you to deliberate whether you truly want to open a possibly distracting app. While it was announced as a core Android 17 feature, Google screwed up big time by limiting it to the Pixel 11 series .

title: ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude quietly get worse over time. This hidden setting fixes them
summary: Your favorite AI chatbot might be remembering a little too much.
body: I’ve been using LLM-based AI in some capacity for roughly half a decade, and in that time, the industry has changed significantly. Not only have newer competitors like Gemini and Claude arrived on the scene, but older tools like ChatGPT have also evolved dramatically. We’ve seen better third-party app integration, increased reasoning capabilities, and countless other advancements. However, I would argue that the ability to retain memories matters most. Retaining context from previous conversations helps the AI better anticipate your needs within a single session. It also allows the tool to learn more about you, ensuring that future conversations are tailored to your preferences. However, there is a real downside to memory accumulation that not everyone considers. I’ve found that starting with a new AI usually requires significant input to generate the responses I need and fully understand my user profile. Once it reaches this data “sweet spot,” the AI becomes much more pleasant to use. Yet, slowly over time, the experience often seems to degrade again.

body: Credit: Taylor Kerns / Android Authority TL;DR Google Calendar is getting an update that allows meeting organizers or their delegates to choose whether or not to receive RSVP emails and automatic responses. The new setting is beneficial for organizers who don’t need to be informed about every individual attendee’s response. The gradual rollout starts today for all Google Workspace customers, Workspace Individual subscribers, and users with personal Google accounts. Have you ever set up a meeting in Google Calendar and gotten overwhelmed by all the RSVP emails and automatic responses? While it can be useful to know who is and isn’t attending your event, having your inbox get flooded by these messages is far from ideal. It’s just one of the app’s annoying quirks . title: Samsung isn’t just copying Apple anymore — it is Apple

body: When the latest leaks and rumors around the Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra dropped earlier this week, they created a bit of a furor in the Android Authority newsroom, and for good reason. Early renders show a wide horizontal camera bar stretching across the back of the phone. It replaces the individual floating lenses Samsung has used for years for a striking change that also looks suspiciously similar to a certain Pro-themed smartphone from Cupertino. For years, we’ve given Samsung a hard time for playing it safe with iterative designs. Now, I’m not saying that critiquing Samsung’s repetitive takes on the same design ID wasn’t well deserved. However, now that the company is trying out something different, I can’t really say it’s for the better. The problem is not that Samsung changed its design language. If you were hoping a software update would eventually bring Google’s smartest Gemini Intelligence features to your older flagship, the latest device list is a good reality check. Google now says Gemini Nano 4 is supported on only seven Android phones, and those are the devices positioned to unlock the newest on-device Gemini experiences. title: Google’s latest attempt at fast wired charging on the Pixel 11 Pro XL is a disaster
summary: What good is Extreme Charging if it doesn't even turn on?
body: If there are two pieces of tech I have a love-hate relationship with, it’s USB-C charging and Google’s Pixel smartphones. At their best, both can be brilliantly hassle-free, but at their worst, they’re a parade of seemingly unnecessary compromises. Based on my previous experiences with Pixels, testing the 45W wired charging capabilities of the new Pixel 11 Pro XL was almost certainly going to cause a headache or two, but it quickly descended into a full-on migraine. Let’s start with the good USB-C news for the Pixel 11 Pro XL. After years of underperforming the headline charging figure, Google’s latest large flagship comes much closer to hitting its 45W marketing claim. While still not quite there, I was able to hit a peak of 40.7W for about the first 9 minutes on the Google Pixel Flex 67W charger (). That’s a reasonable power level and far better sustained than rivals that claim up to 100W capabilities, plus it exceeds the 35W peak I’ve observed on the previous two generations of XL smartphones. So a pat on the back there.

title: Meta fixes distressingly obvious smart glasses recording LED loophole
summary: You won't believe how easy it was to bypass Meta privacy protections.
body: TL;DR Meta’s smart glasses attempt to detect when their recording LED is blocked or tampered with, and will refuse to start filming. It turns out this check was only performed when recordings were initiated, and users could just start filming and cover the LED afterwards. Meta is currently rolling out a fix to correct this behavior. Retro gamers may remember the old PlayStation 1 swap trick: The system would only check disc integrity when first booting, so you could run imports or backups by first powering the PlayStation up with a legit disc in it, and then quickly swapping it out. It turns out that Meta’s smart glasses have been vulnerable to a similar attack, and the company is only just now getting around to patching it. Everybody’s concerned about smart glasses and privacy right now, and probably the biggest issue there is centered on surreptitious recording. Even though we all carry around phones capable of sneakily recording videos, some folks are just really upset about the idea that someone could film them with smart glasses, and they’d never know it. title: Android 17 has some new tricks to keep your web traffic private
summary: Here's how Android 17 is locking down your network traffic from prying eyes.
body: TL;DR Google’s implementing a number of new network security upgrades for Android 17. Encrypted Client Hello attempts to solve DNS privacy problems by encrypting server lookups. SMS Blaster protection empowers carriers to block low-security 2G connections by default. Keeping mobile devices secure is one of those jobs that never end, and when it comes to security in Android, Google finds itself constantly working to lock our phones down against external threats. With Android 17 , the company’s already highlighted some of the big ways it’s been improving security , and today Google has a few more updates to share on how your phone is becoming more secure and private that ever. Android 17 makes a number of changes to how devices work with network traffic. One big privacy-protecting one there impacts how apps are able to see your home’s local network, preventing them from probing it for fingerprinting or even spotting vulnerable network hardware. Another we knew about implements Certificate Transparency by default, helping ensure that your phone uses the proper SSL certificates for the server it’s trying to communicate with.
